sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 14 (check 13) and Internal Quality Checks row 14 (no annotation on this row); Deterministic Checks rows for check-assets-referenced.py and check-fixtures.py
evidence: Paths named by the brief: instruction.md:3 names '/instructions' ('the six notes') and '/assets/seed_data.json'; integration.md:7 names '/assets/seed_data.json'; integration.md:5 names security.md; policy.md:3 names ui.md. All exist: environment/instructions holds exactly six notes (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security, ui) and environment/assets/seed_data.json exists (149 bytes, parses as JSON). environment/Dockerfile:14-16 has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; the Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template's. task.toml:2 declares artifacts ['/app','/assets'] and tests/test.sh:88 only chmods /assets, both as in the template. Content agreement: the seed is {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}; integration.md:7 says it 'describes the starting scope and contains no user snippets or starter implementation' and instruction.md:3 says 'there is no starter app to finish' - both true of the file. The golden never reads /assets (no seed or readFileSync reference in solution/app/server.js; the only bulk INSERT at server.js:167 is a revision backfill from its own snippets table) and solve.sh:37 removes any app.db so it starts with an empty library, matching the empty seed. Judges do not assume seeded content: no criterion or prompt mentions the seed, and tests/app_context.md:21 says 'Do not assume an empty library', so neither a seeded nor an empty start is presumed. Counter-probes: an app that ignores /assets entirely loses nothing (nothing graded depends on it); a conforming app that imports the empty 'snippets' array ends in the same state as the golden, so it cannot fail on asset grounds. Limits: this is a source review; check-assets-referenced.py and check-fixtures.py were applied by hand (private executables not run) and no image build was observed in this review, and the raw evidence index covers scripted golden behaviour only - none of that is needed to decide this static row.
